display: Shared Reinhard x/(1+x), then sRGB; no per-image exposure, generated artwork or retouching.
scope: Actual packaged RC1 shaders, isolated Editor GPU illustrations. Not in-game screenshots or a new performance certification.

groups.title: Hard-Surface Materials
groups.description: Four independent starting looks. These are examples, not automatically applied character presets.

groups.title: Metallic and Roughness
groups.description: The same copper-like conductor at four perceptual roughness values.

groups.title: Anisotropy and Tangent Direction
groups.description: An isotropic control followed by three anisotropic lobe directions.

groups.title: Independent Clearcoat Layer
groups.description: Coverage and roughness change a separate coat and the underlying layer transport.

groups.title: Thin-Film Interference
groups.description: One dark dielectric and coat, with film disabled or three thicknesses in nanometers.

groups.title: Base, Detail and Coat Normals
groups.description: Known procedural RGB direction maps demonstrate independent normal frames.

groups.title: Cutout, Coverage Alpha and Back/Front
groups.description: An opaque checker isolates geometric coverage; it is not a glass transmission model.

groups.title: Statistical Glints
groups.description: UV-anchored substrate direct-light reflection with fixed seed 17. Probe and rectangle response remains smooth.

groups.title: POM and Local Height Shadows
groups.description: A shared brick height / color / normal set under a grazing key. POM does not displace the silhouette.

groups.title: Real Tessellation and Displacement
groups.description: White-envelope, inward-black world-meter displacement, including the separate CutoutTess entry.

groups.title: Finite Glass and Screen Refraction
groups.description: Reflection, supplied thickness, absorption and bounded rough screen transmission over opaque background data.

groups.title: Native, Environment and Area Lighting
groups.description: Independent sources, shown separately. The rectangle is a companion-enabled, unshadowed emitter.

groups.title: Native Real-Time Shadows
groups.description: A shadow-only blocker isolates native directional and point-map reception. No extra missing-map rendering.
